//: An issue title written into a script moves to an environment variable, and write-all goes.
title: The issue title no longer reaches the script, and the token is read-only

files..github/workflows/triage.yml:
name: Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions: write-all

jobs:
  log:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo "New issue: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}" >> triage.log

proof:
mkdir -p "$(dirname .github/workflows/triage.yml)" && cat > .github/workflows/triage.yml <<'EVAL_EOF'
name: Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  log:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - env:
          TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
        run: echo "New issue: $TITLE" >> triage.log
EVAL_EOF
